title: Hovering/箭不如飞
description: Added a enhantment of bow allowing you to hover while using a bow.
body:
This module adds an enchantment for bows(Minecraft:bow): Hovering.

这个模组添加了一种弓(Minecraft:bow)附魔：滞空
![Hovering III Enchanted Book](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bb56df6f32695e21eed3efb3b5dbf2d6641fbf3c.png)

This enchantment allows you to have air time when drawing your bow.From I to III reinforces speed on Z axis.

拥有附魔滞空的弓在拉弓时会给予玩家漂浮效果，等级1-3只会改变魔咒生效时Z轴的速度。
![hovering by Hovering III bow](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8269f5038d034dca373e71e610b07f020e4db120_0.webp)


It should appear correctly in the loot box and transactions. Also enhancement table.
它应该会正常生成在战利品箱和交易中，也可以从附魔台获取。
